entries.note: Sanity predictor. Recall and F1 must be zero.

entries.name: naive_keyword_rules
entries.note: Simple referral-completion and exact duplicate rules over frozen extracted events; no normalization layer beyond frozen event fields and no evidence gate.

entries.name: oracle_events_upper_bound
entries.note: Gold canonical events plus deterministic rules; diagnostic upper bound, not deployable.

entries.name: full_hybrid_fixture_replay
entries.note: Full extracted -> detector -> evidence -> priority path using frozen fixture extraction.

entries.name: llm_only_gap_judge

limitations: The naive baseline shares the frozen fixture-extracted event store; it tests simpler judgment, not simpler extraction.
The LLM-only baseline was not run because no provider was configured.
The oracle-events baseline is an upper bound, not a competitor.

cases.name: stale_event_store

corruption.not_run_reason: Contradicted-absence corruption is covered by Phase 7 absence-policy tests and is not injected here because it requires mutating the event store rather than the evidence package.

cost.note: No live LLM calls or token usage exist in the fixture replay. Dollar cost is not measured and is reported as null.

limitations: The end-to-end path starts from frozen fixture-extracted events, not live LLM extraction.
Synthetic records and benchmark monitoring policies do not establish clinical validity.

all_predictions_scope.interpretation: All extracted events in the partition versus the partial gold sample; false positives include unannotated true events and are not interpretable as hallucination.

annotated_scope.interpretation: Predictions restricted to documents included in the frozen extraction-gold annotation sample.

extraction.claim: Fixture replay only. These extraction numbers verify the evaluation plumbing and frozen artifacts; they are not live extractor-v1 model quality.
limitations: The available extraction store is produced by the deterministic fixture extractor, not a live LLM.
Extraction gold is a 12-patient / 130-event annotation sample, so all-partition precision is not meaningful.
No live extraction latency or token cost can be attributed from this run.

extraction_loss.interpretation: 0 recall points separate the oracle-event and extracted-event pipelines in this fixture run.
